title: Origami batch recommender: continuous workload sketches, safety fences, and rollback choreography
creator: Asha Menon
description: Goal: Ship a recommendation engine ('Origami') that continuously sketches per-workload batching profiles from live traffic, synthesizes lightweight heuristics (min/max batch size, max-delay, KV-affinity), and applies configuration changes gradually using a safe choreography (shadow evaluation -> canary -> ramp -> rollback). This ticket covers design, prototype, and runbook for rollout and failure modes.
acceptance_criteria: Origami can ingest 1 hour of request telemetry and emit a recommended batching profile for a route within 10 minutes
Each recommended change can be shadow-applied (simulated) with a cost/latency delta estimate and a safety score
Safe-apply choreography exists and is automated: shadow -> canary (1% traffic) -> progressive ramp -> automatic rollback on triggers
Alerting and rollback triggers are implemented: p95 latency > baseline + 25ms, error-rate uplift > 0.5%, inference fidelity regression on evaluation prompts
Documentation and runbook written with manual override and emergency revert instructions
implementation_notes: Telemetry inputs: token-length histogram, inter-arrival time distribution, KV cache hit ratio by prefix hash, model-version, route tags
Sketch summarization: use reservoir sampling + time-decayed histograms to bound memory; store sketches in per-customer TTL buckets
Heuristics generator: rule-based first pass (kv-affinity grouping, min-safe-batch based on tail latency), then small gradient-free tuner to propose delay thresholds
Simulator: replay sketch against candidate batch config to estimate delta for cost and p95/p99 latency using calibrated per-GPU kernel profiles
Safe-apply choreography: always run shadow (no external effect) and compute predicted regressions before any live rollout
Metrics to emit: recommended.min_batch, recommended.max_batch, recommended.max_delay_ms, predicted_cost_delta_pct, safety_score (0-100), shadow_sim_p95_ms, observed_coalesce_rate
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: model output quality may degrade if batching delays introduce context drift — Mitigation: include eval prompts tied to routes and run fidelity checks during shadow and canary phases
Risk: telemetry sampling bias could produce bad recommendations — Mitigation: require minimum traffic volume threshold and fallback to conservative defaults when below threshold
Risk: rollouts might oscillate under bursty traffic — Mitigation: use hysteresis + minimum hold window (15 minutes) before further changes; prefer rate-limited ramps
Risk: catastrophic config change applied at scale — Mitigation: automated immediate rollback triggers and manual emergency revert with one-click in Console
rollout_plan: Stage 0 - Lab: unit tests + simulator validation against historical week of traces (dev infra)
Stage 1 - Shadow: enable for 10 routes with low customer exposure, collect fidelity and cost deltas for 48 hours
Stage 2 - Canary: automated canary on 1% traffic for selected routes for 2 hours; require no trigger to proceed
Stage 3 - Progressive Ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m hold at each step and health gating
Stage 4 - Continuous: Origami runs weekly per-route refinements; any regressive change triggers roll-forward to previous safe profile
